description: Log honey extracted and optionally add directly to stock inventory. ALWAYS ask for confirmation before writing.

addToInventory.description: Automatically add honey weight to inventory stock (defaults to false)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

hiveId.description: The unique hive ID (optional if yardId is provided)

supersPulled.description: Optional count of honey supers pulled (integer)

weight.description: Harvested honey weight in lbs (positive number)

yardId.description: The apiary yard ID (optional if hiveId is provided)

name: log_honey_harvest
